svg.title: Dependency Review: Customs at the Border
svg.desc: A pull request's dependency changes are checked against the advisory database and the license allow list, and a required dependency review check blocks the merge on a high-severity vulnerability or a disallowed license.
svg.text: Dependency Review: Customs at the Border
A required check stops new risk at the pull request; alerts watch what's already merged.
Pull request adds or updates dependencies
Watch merged code, don't block PRs
Make it ruleset-required so teams can't weaken it
